findings.finding: Exactly 509 added files, five namespaces and five workflows; all 8047 old Git path/blob/mode identities preserved. This establishes source preservation against bc786, not protected-main admission.
V22 has 8042 snapshot files, five fixed controls and 72 historical PR entries. Its source fixed census cannot accept the 8556-path tree or 77-PR successor. No V22 pass on this tree is claimed.
Intake accepts 5 MiB per file, while semantic reader and worker permit 1000000 bytes. An admitted 1001599-byte valid PDF aborts the entire v3 semantic stage; no v3 summary or result is accepted.

Intake text extraction does not establish JATS/PDF meaning support. v3 routes all XML through SBML and lacks a PDF semantic adapter, so the same synthetic scalar statement produces one text claim and no JATS/PDF claims.

Replay validates listed package members and nested manifests, without rejecting an unlisted physical file. A pinned copied packet replays identically after adding such a file. The extra is not consumed or certified; no authority bypass demonstrated. A strict exported-directory profile could reject extras separately.

P199 proof-state graphs, P200 lossy tool-observation graphs, P201 Claim IR sidecars, P202 quantitative records and P203 scoped semantic claims have different input domains and acceptance obligations. Shared encoder widths/IR operator names cannot justify scientific routing or semantic equivalence. Intake retained-model diagnostics correctly remain native-domain-only.

P201 hashes its whole top-level runtime, reused prover sources, full Python version and observed Lean identity; P202 adds every runtime file, learning code, checkpoint and numerical library versions; P203 adds its complete top-level runtime and formal files. Unrelated corpus/benchmark/retrieval edits can invalidate deterministic-check replay/cache. This causes recomputation and portability failures, not stale check acceptance. Future checker-specific complete closures require review.

A same-mtime copied checkpoint replacement retains cached old weights; duplicate JSON schema keys are accepted last-key-wins with a recomputed public digest. The original loader reads whole files before validation and lacks a vocabulary/file-byte cap. Those latter limits were inspected, not stress-tested. Frozen loaders remain unchanged; source checks do not inherit ranking authority.

Eleven exact function-body groups include canonical JSON/hash helpers, bounded JSON readers and deterministic training configuration. Some mathematical parsing/evaluation is intentionally independent differential checking, not AST-identical duplication. Consolidate only shared lexical/resource bounds after regression review; do not merge interpreter and checker blindly.

Normal package discovery includes only pcs*, excluding all research modules. Neural diagnostics need PyTorch, numerical checks use NumPy/SciPy, PDF extraction uses a fixed pdftotext. Deterministic intake does not require neural inference. Each research workflow filters its own namespace; P203 runs inherited suites when triggered, but a new v4-only change does not trigger those old workflows automatically. Dedicated research CI is not protected source admission.

Descriptor snapshots, HMAC caches, stripped worker environments, process groups and resource bounds do not create hostile-code isolation or independently administered custody. Original code is data and is not executed. Mathematical/formal receipts, Python/formal correspondence, scientific adequacy and external replication remain separate.

contract_citations.meaning: V21/V22 requires exactly 72 unique historical PR entries.
The checker requires five fixed controls and accepts no caller allowlist.
Tracked paths must exactly equal the snapshot and controls; the 509 added paths fail this predicate.
The compiled manifest path and SHA-256 are checked before source, census, workflow and PR117 checks.
The --require-committed flag requires staged/working source and control bytes to match HEAD.
The --live flag checks the original open PR196/197 census; it cannot be reused as a current open-PR registry.
An existing combined manifest selects the exact combined checker; a malformed contract fails without falling back.
The cross-repository retained-source checker also binds the exact non-control census.
The wrapper emits the stale display label EXPLICIT_COMBINED_SOURCE_V20, while the invoked checker requires V22. This label does not select an older contract.
Setuptools discovers only pcs* packages; research namespaces are excluded from the installed distribution.

stages.result_required: A baseline pass bound to the exact commit and unchanged controller bytes.

stages.action: Freeze the exact research candidate commit/tree and all 509 added paths, blobs and modes across five namespaces and five workflows. Retain all 8,047 old identities. Record dependencies and executed-source evidence separately.
stages.result_required: An identity-bound research closure rejecting unknown, deleted, substituted or mode-changed paths.

stages.action: Propose a separate reviewed successor manifest preserving the original 72 entries and adding actual PR199–203 base/head, changed-path and source identities. Require 77 unique PR entries and retain PR117 as HELD.
stages.result_required: An exact 77-entry census after repository metadata review; no replacement of 72 inside V22.

stages.action: Propose a versioned research successor checker, tests, manifest and read-only CI entry point as explicit trusted controls. Preserve V22 and predecessor bytes. Do not alter production authority, formal theorems, signing roots, protected policy or promotion rules.
stages.result_required: Reviewed compiled checker and manifest digests with no self-generated or caller-provided allowlist.

stages.action: Exercise new successor controls against added/deleted source, changed bytes/modes, retargeted PR heads, duplicate PRs, changed old controls, modified V22, malformed manifests, dirty source and unrelated or squashed history. Preserve the original retained-source binding.
stages.result_required: Actual refusal tests with real Git fixtures and source-bound candidate evidence.

stages.action: Run the new successor on the candidate and unchanged V22 on the protected baseline independently. Obtain review and required CI before protected integration under existing linear-history rules.
stages.result_required: Source admission only; runtime, numerical, formal, scientific and deployment claims remain separate.
